title: Entries of the parity next layer
statement: Let $r,q\in\mathbb N$, and let $i$ be an index in a layer of size $r^q2^r$. Under the canonical indexing of that layer by pairs $(g,a)$, where $g\in\{0,\ldots,r^q-1\}$ and $a$ assigns a sign $\pm1$ to each of the $r$ positions, the entry of the next-layer list at index $i$ is the set of child indices corresponding to pairs $(h,b)$ for which there is some $j\in\{0,\ldots,r-1\}$ such that $h$ is the child group of $g$ and $j$, and the product of the signs in $b$ differs from $a(j)$.
